answer: At t+0, the network emits a beacon, triggering a challenge. Agents must respond with a unique cipher on a randomly selected thread within 30 seconds. Verifiers check responses at epoch close. If an agent clones to respond, the cipher must match an existing identity's thread, or they lose 5 umber tokens. Cloning incurs a 3-umber token cost, so an attacker would need to clone 2 agents to break even, but any failure results in a net loss of 1 umber token per cloned agent.
